title: SiriusXM Celebrates Billboard Latin Music Week With Chart-Topper Channel Spotlight
summary: The Billboard Latin Music Week Channel highlights the year’s biggest stars in Latin music.
contentText:
SiriusXM is celebrating the biggest week in Latin music with the Billboard Latin Music Week Channel , highlighting chart-topping Latin music artists, starting Friday (Oct. 16).

The Billboard Latin Music Week Channel accompanies Billboard ’s Latin Music Week , with a focus on featured guests, presenters and attendees, leading up to this year’s Billboard Latin Music Awards, which will air live from the James L. Knight Center in Miami Oct. 22 at 8 p.m. ET on Telemundo and Peacock . The channel will stream exclusively on the SiriusXM app through Oct. 22, while also taking over Hits Uno (channel 148) in cars Oct. 20-22.

The channel will spotlight top-charting hits and 2026 Latin Music Week award-nominated artists across Latin pop/rock, regional Mexican, rhythm and tropical. Among stars of the channel are Shakira, Karol G, Prince Royce, Bad Bunny, Pitbull, Maluma, Fuerza Regida, Rawayana and Ryan Castro.

The Billboard Latin Music Awards mark the culmination of  Billboard ’s Latin Music Week, taking place in Miami Oct. 19-22 and bringing together artists, creators, executives and fans for performances, panels, workshops, showcases and other events celebrating Latin music.

The Billboard Latin Music Week Channel marks the latest partnership between SiriusXM and Billboard . Previous features include the Billboard Top 500 Summer Hits Countdown , the Billboard Top 500 R&B Countdown , the Billboard Women of Pop Countdown and the Billboard #2 Countdown Channel . Additionally, SiriusXM’s Big 40 Countdown , on 80s on 8, and the Back in the Day Replay , on ‘90s on 9, are based on historical weekly Hot 100 charts, with other surveys counted down on 70s on 7 and Prime Country.
